curation.notes: Compared 2026-10-08: a and b agree on every mean, SD and unit for all 17 rows (checked again against the image, NDC Analysis.png). Differences settled: (1) source wording on all 17 rows (prose only) -> one wording, 'NDC sheet, <section> section, row <n> <label>', from the image's own section headings and row numbers; (2) #23 FMA definitionMatch a='close' b='same' -> 'same': owner ruling C9 (NUS uses Go–Me) settles #23 over #22. Doubts settled: Wits −4.7 printed with its minus (Skeletal row 7), catalogue Jacobson sign, 'same'; E-line rows 16-17 printed positive, read with the catalogue sign rule (+ = lip ahead), 'same' (nothing on the sheet indicates the reverse); #29 LAFH% points not printed, read as ANS–Me/N–Me, 'same'; #64 L1 to APo tip vs labial not printed, tip per C1, 'same' (nothing indicates otherwise); #68/#69 reference plane not printed, functional occlusal plane per C7, 'same'; C9 Go–Me for #23, #25 and #57, 'same'. scale written as true-size per owner ruling 8 Oct (extractions carried the old magnificationCorrected key). Caveat on origin per ruling: the sheet names no author, year, sample or Lew. Fix round 1 (2026-10-08, review): placeholder year 2026 removed, citation marked undated; ethnicity emptied (not stated on the sheet); Wits note cites So 1990 via Moate & Darendeliler 2002 Table V; E-line notes argue from the catalogue sign rule only.

caveats: The NDC sheet states no author, year or sample size; its origin is NUS teaching (owner).
No date is printed on the sheet: the citation is marked undated (no year), so its source line reads "NDC (undated)".
Authors as printed: only 'NDC' appears, in the title '+Resident Analysis (NDC)'; the leading '+' is read as a software expand/collapse glyph, not part of the title. No reference list.
Sex and age not stated: all 17 values entered as pooled, with no age band.
Ethnicity of the sheet's sample is not stated.

No definitions printed: only labels, units, means and SDs. The mandibular plane (Go–Me, owner ruling C9), the overjet/overbite direction (functional occlusal plane, C7) and the incisor point for L1 to APo (tip, C1) come from owner rulings and the catalogue, not from the sheet.
The sheet's 'Actual' column is blank (a fill-in column for the patient's value).

entries.note: Sheet label 'FMA'. Mandibular plane Go–Me (#23, not the tangent #22) per owner ruling C9 (NUS uses Go–Me; Eastman tradition). The sheet itself does not name the plane.
Sheet label 'MMPA' (maxillary–mandibular planes angle): palatal plane ANS–PNS to Go–Me, mandibular plane per owner ruling C9. The sheet does not name the planes.

Minus sign printed on the sheet. The sheet states no sign rule or occlusal plane; read with the catalogue's Jacobson sign (BO behind AO positive), along the standard occlusal plane (molars to incisors) per owner ruling NUS-OP-1 (16 Oct 2026: NUS uses the standard plane; until then the functional plane). So 1990's Chinese values −4.9 (M) / −4.5 (F), Jacobson sign, functional occlusal plane, appear second-hand in Moate & Darendeliler 2002 Table V (extracted; merge pending, Task 9a).

Unit printed as %; the sheet does not state the ratio's points. Read as the catalogue's ANS–Me / N–Me × 100 (Eastman/Naini usage, 'about 55%'); 53.9% fits that ratio and nothing on the sheet indicates another.
